# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 18 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 18:3 — "closed/sealed every source"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "closed every source of understanding" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "sealed every source of discernment" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "bricked up every source of understanding" | Vivid dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted composite: "sealed every source of understanding."
**Status:** Resolved with composite.

---

## 18:8 — "broken vessel" vs. "shattered vessel" vs. "smashed jar"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "broken vessel" | Consistent with Col. 17 |
| LOGOS | "shattered vessel" | More emphatic |
| PNEUMA | "smashed jar" | Colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "broken vessel" -- consistent with Col. 17 ruling.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 18:19 — "torn from its socket" vs. "wrenched from its joint" vs. "ripped from its socket"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "torn from its socket" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "wrenched from its joint" | Formal variant |
| PNEUMA | "ripped from its socket" | Dynamic, violent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "torn from its socket."
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 18:25 — tzeror ha-chayyim: "bundle of the living" vs. "pouch of life" vs. "bundle of life"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "bundle of the living" | Literal: chayyim = the living (1 Sam 25:29) |
| LOGOS | "pouch of life" | "Pouch" for tzeror |
| PNEUMA | "bundle of life" | Standard modern |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "bundle of the living" -- chayyim is specifically "the living."
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 18:27 — "strengthened my heart" vs. "fortified my heart" vs. "braced my heart"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "strengthened my heart" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "fortified my heart" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "braced my heart" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "strengthened my heart."
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 18:28 — hesed: "covenant-faithfulness" vs. "lovingkindness" vs. "faithful love"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "covenant-faithfulness" | Project convention |
| LOGOS | "lovingkindness" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "faithful love" | Modern |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "covenant-faithfulness" per project convention.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 18:30 — "abandoned" vs. "forsaken" vs. "walked away"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "abandoned" | Standard |
| LOGOS | "forsaken" | Formal, biblical |
| PNEUMA | "walked away" | Colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "abandoned."
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 18:** 7
